summary: Persist failed GitHub autosync and drain bounded retries

delivery.outcome: Persist failed GitHub ticket autosync, expose pending/failed state and provide a bounded opt-in retry worker; verify and publish the repaired producer.
nonGoals: Automatic source commits for tracker reconciliation

architecture.decision: A repository-bound SQLite outbox journals explicit CLI GitHub autosync before network effects. Revision and worker-token CAS preserve newer edits; failure retains safe error codes and cooldown. The opt-in retry CLI loads current native records and uses the existing exact-ticket sync/readback contract.
interfaceChanges: sync retry CLI and ticket-show retry projection

dataChanges.description: Private repository-bound GitHub retry journal; no migration or transfer of domain data

architecture.rollback: Revert the protected merge; retain the external outbox.

validation.evidence: Crash/restart durability, revision fencing, backoff/Retry-After, no-sync/dry-run, exact routing, lost-response replay, actual scoped GitHub canary and independent protected publication.
